# One added field for this reading: `H` (read with `ladder/stage-a-reader-brief.md`)

Answer every field of the reading form as it says. Add one more field to each row, `H`: a list with exactly one entry for each part
listed in `other_fields.not_judged`, in its order (like `B`); `[]` when nothing is listed and for a `no_ladder`.

For each listed part, one of:

| Value | When |
|---|---|
| `part` | it is something the thesis's description or outcome names that the judged question leaves out: a second figure or event, a condition, a comparison, or a difference inside an outcome that no rung separates |
| `already_judged` | the judged question's own rungs already decide it: one of its outcomes or ranges is exactly this, so listing it as not judged is wrong |
| `settlement` | it names only where or how the answer will be known (a filing, a data source, a disclosure route), not something the thesis asks |
| `cannot_tell` | the item does not let you decide between the above |

Read the rungs as the judge is shown them (`ladder_as_the_judge_is_shown_it`) before marking `already_judged`: a rung decides a part
only when holding that rung says whether the part happened. Give the reason for any value other than `part` in `why`.
- **One class at a time** (Alex, 2026-10-29: "你一类一类改，快速迭代然后测regression"). Count the misses by mechanism; take the largest
  class; trace it to the sentence that causes it; change one thing aimed at that class; run the whole bench (a prompt change alters every
  request) against the previous version; read every regression to its raw answer. The pages that showed the failure locate its
  mechanism; only the whole bench (every set, every draw) accepts the change.
- **Name the effect on the judgement first.** Every proposed change states the effect it is expected to have on a reader or on the final
  judgement, and is tested there where possible; a step's own counts do not decide it alone. A fix that keeps moving its error to
  neighbouring cases stops being tuned on that set (Alex, 2026-11-09: "感觉现在一直在修一些mknor的原地打转，你是不是要思考下现在具体还差什么high priority big impact 的需要做？";
  he approved this rule the same day, D391).
- **A model call is a sampler.** Re-send a stored request before calling its answer a defect. Totals and acceptance come from at least
  three samples beside a fresh control; a bar the control fails against itself judges nothing. A direct-read pass
  (one send per article, every answer read beside its source; D238) locates mechanisms; its counts are one draw and are labelled so.

item.text:
**No-go on v3 yet.** The new wording addresses the grouped-choice problem, but the design’s required result conflicts with how the existing reading has treated the motivating example.

The control requires termination to remain listed when “Ruled out” groups it with another case. In A2, however, the readers or third readers marked termination as `already_judged`, contributing to the H failures. A3 could therefore satisfy its new control and still be penalised for the same entry under the inherited reading and harm count. Resolve that disagreement **before** a send: specify how the unchanged brief applies to grouped choices, test the actual examples with the readers, and say how disagreement is counted. Do not silently change the frozen gate accounting. [A3 control](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/DESIGN-A3.md:39>), [A2 result](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/RESULT-A2.md:19>), [H brief](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/h-brief.md:11>)

Two smaller points also need correction:

- The sentence says to remove a source-only entry, then to keep any part some choice leaves unsettled. State that the source-only exception takes precedence, so the two directions cannot conflict. [A3 sentence](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/DESIGN-A3.md:14>)
- A fault appearing in the control, in a field the sentence does not directly address, is **pre-existing**, not proven unaffected by the change. A prompt addition can alter other fields. Likewise, an entry matching the new instruction is consistent with the proposed mechanism, but is not by itself proof of causation. Keep those attributions qualified. [Attribution rule](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/DESIGN-A3.md:51>)

CONSENSUS: no, because the grouped-choice control and the existing H reading can reward and penalise the same output.
